body:
Ok, there's more going on here than just in `NavigationAgent3D::_transition_to_navigation_finished()`.  I added a check there for `use_3d_avoidance`, and found that if navigation finishes, we stop updating `stored_y_velocity`.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/9b22b41531c82132732fda0f9818c5709c2587bc/scene/3d/navigation/navigation_agent_3d.cpp#L313-L329

Generally it looks like `stored_y_velocity` should just be stored in `set_velocity` unless `use_3d_avoidance` is set.  Looking at the code path, `stored_y_velocity` is mutually exclusive with `use_3d_avoidance`.  That simplifies things.

Updated the MRP to show better details of what is going on, both on screen and via print.  Here's it running with the fixes.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5d15ce92-155e-4798-a7e0-6a822f939491

[navigation-agent-avoidance-gravity-issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21059746/navigation-agent-avoidance-gravity-issue.zip)

I'll open a PR shortly.
